svg.title: Three fictional calls in the “phantom hacker” scam, each handing off to the next
svg.desc: Call 1: a pop-up says your computer is infected and to call support now; the caller wants remote access to your computer. Call 2: your bank's “fraud department” says a hacker is inside your accounts and not to tell anyone at the branch; the caller wants you to log in while they watch. Call 3: a “federal agent” says to move your savings to a safe account they control, or into gold or cash for a courier; the caller wants your money in a form that can't come back. None of the callers is real. Hang up and call your bank yourself, at the number on the back of your card. Fictional, for illustration.
